blocks.eyebrow: Signs you are using too much
blocks.heading: Stinging, redness, light flaking — while following every instruction correctly
quotes: “Serum, toner, essence, masks. The more complete the routine, the more it stings.”
“All good products, all used together, and my face went red with no way to tell which one.”
“Retinol made me flake. I was told to push through, so I did.”
“A week off everything and my skin calmed right down — but the marks came back darker.”

explainer.heading: With a damaged barrier, every active behind it is beside the point
body: The outermost layer keeps water in and irritants out. When it weakens, actives penetrate faster than intended — which is why the same product can feel fine one week and sting the next.
This phase needs fewer things acting on the skin, not more. The four groups printed on this jar are all hydrating and soothing; there are no brightening or exfoliating actives in it.
It is a basic moisturising step. We call it that rather than a treatment, because putting treatment expectations on a moisturiser is the fastest way to be disappointed by one.

blocks.heading: Three phases, and which one this jar is for
blocks.intro: A basic moisturiser cannot do an active's job. Said plainly so you do not buy the wrong expectation.

items.heading: Recently irritated, peeled, or off retinol
items.body: Exactly the phase this jar exists for: few ingredients, no strong actives, and a quiet stretch for the skin.

items.heading: Dry year-round, no pigmentation concerns
items.body: Fine as a long-term daily moisturiser. No reason to move to a busier formula while your skin is settled.

items.heading: Working on melasma or dark marks
items.body: There are no brightening actives here. It keeps the barrier in shape so other steps can work, but on its own it does not act on pigment — you need something else.

blocks.heading: Four groups, and what each one does
blocks.intro: This is a base formula: hydrate and calm, with nothing acting on pigment.

rows.name: Pro-vitamin B5 (panthenol)
rows.role: Humectant, aimed at easing tightness and redness.

rows.name: Centella extract
rows.role: A familiar member of the calming group.

rows.name: Hyaluronic acid

rows.name: Plant stem cell extract

blocks.eyebrow: Where it sits in the day
blocks.heading: The last step, morning and night
blocks.intro: While skin needs quiet, a shorter routine is better. This is the minimum.

steps.label: Rinse with cool water
steps.note: During this phase you can skip the morning cleanser.

steps.label: Collagen Peptide Cream
steps.note: Apply while skin is still slightly damp to hold that water in.

steps.label: Sunscreen
steps.note: Weakened skin darkens more easily after every exposure.

steps.label: Pause the strong actives
steps.note: Retinol, exfoliating acids, high-strength vitamin C — stop until the stinging ends.

steps.label: Collagen Peptide Cream
steps.note: A slightly thicker layer than the morning.

blocks.footnote: Most skin settles within one to two weeks once actives are reduced. If it is still stinging, red or flaking after two weeks, that is no longer a moisturiser's job — see a dermatologist.

blocks.heading: Two steps
blocks.intro: The order is taken from the manufacturer's instructions.

items.heading: Dot on five points
items.body: A pea-sized amount across both cheeks, chin, forehead and nose.

items.heading: Spread and pat in
items.body: Pat gently until absorbed; do not rub.

blocks.footnote: If you are running a routine with pigment-targeting actives, pick one cream rather than layering both — extra layers add congestion risk, not extra effect.

items.q: How is it different from Smart Brightening Cream?
items.a: Different purpose entirely. The brightening cream carries pigment-targeting actives; this one is a base moisturiser that hydrates and calms. Use this when skin needs a rest, the other when you are running a pigmentation routine.

items.q: Can I use both at once?
items.a: Layering two moisturisers is not advisable. Pick one, according to the phase your skin is in.
Somewhere dry and cool, away from direct sunlight and heat. Close the lid tightly after use.
